documents.text: The details ( from wikipedia ) Biography Jon Hill ( c. 1954 ) is an American chef who was White House Executive Chef from October 1 , 1987 , to January 7 , 1988 . He was the first American-born chef to serve in the capacity . Early life and education Hill was born in Spokane , Washington , about 1954 to Victor M. Hill , a chef and instructor of hotel-motel and restaurant management at Spokane Community College . His grandfather was also a chef . Hill fell in love with fine cooking at the age of 16 .
